title: China hits out at Pentagon report alleging bid to weaken US-India ties

title: Why India should relax about Trump tariffs and speak the language of strategy without embarrassment
description: India should not fear Trump's tariffs or overtures to Pakistan, as the US strategic realignment toward India is driven by deeper geopolitical factors.
